translations.web: His delight will be in the fear of Yahweh. He will not judge by the sight of his eyes, neither decide by the hearing of his ears;
translations.bsb: And He will delight in the fear of the LORD. He will not judge by what His eyes see, and He will not decide by what His ears hear,
translations.kjv: And shall make him of quick understanding in the fear of the LORD: and he shall not judge after the sight of his eyes, neither reprove after the hearing of his ears:
translations.asv: And his delight shall be in the fear of Jehovah; and he shall not judge after the sight of his eyes, neither decide after the hearing of his ears;
